params.amountIn: exact amount of hops[0].tokenIn to sell (already approved to this adapter)
params.amountOutMin: minimum acceptable FINAL amountOut (leg-level slippage guard)
params.deadline: unix timestamp passed straight through to the underlying router call.                     MUST be the caller's real submission-time deadline (e.g. TriangleArb's                     own `deadline` argument), NOT a freshly computed `block.timestamp + N`                     inside the adapter — recomputing it at execution time makes the router's                     own deadline check a no-op, since `block.timestamp` there is always "now."
params.hops: ordered chain of same-adapter hops; hops[0].tokenIn is what                     TriangleArb approved `amountIn` of; hops[i].tokenIn must equal                     hops[i-1].tokenOut for i > 0

returns.amountOut: actual amount of the final hop's tokenOut sent back to the caller (TriangleArb)
